title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Network-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to release a PDU session.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to modify a PDU session.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to release a PDU session.

entities.name: Re-establishment of user-plane resources
entities.description: Procedure to re-establish user-plane resources for a PDU session.

entities.name: Timer T3592
entities.description: Timer used for retransmission of PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message in network-requested PDU session release procedure.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by SMF to UE to initiate PDU session release.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to SMF to request PDU session modification.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to SMF to request PDU session release.

entities.name: Timer T3592 expiry
entities.description: Condition when timer T3592 expires, triggering retransmission or procedure abortion.

entities.name: Collision with UE-requested modification
entities.description: Condition when SMF receives PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST during network-requested release procedure for same PDU session.

entities.name: Collision with UE-requested release
entities.description: Condition when SMF receives PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST after sending PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND for same PDU session.

entities.name: Collision with user-plane re-establishment
entities.description: Condition when SMF receives indication to re-establish user-plane resources during network-requested release procedure for same PDU session.

entities.name: Ignore PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: SMF behavior to ignore received PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST and proceed with network-requested release procedure.

entities.name: Ignore PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST
entities.description: SMF behavior to ignore received PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST and proceed with network-requested release procedure.

entities.name: Do not re-establish user-plane resources
entities.description: SMF behavior to not re-establish user-plane resources and proceed with network-requested release procedure.

relations.description: Network-requested PDU session release procedure starts timer T3592.
Network-requested PDU session release procedure includes sending PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message.
Timer T3592 expiry condition guards retransmission of PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message.
On first four expiries of timer T3592, SMF resets and restarts the timer.
Collision with UE-requested modification establishes the property to ignore the modification request.
Collision with UE-requested release establishes the property to ignore the release request.
Collision with user-plane re-establishment establishes the property to not re-establish user-plane resources.
UE-requested PDU session modification procedure includes sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.
UE-requested PDU session release procedure includes sending PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message.
